text: Ɓen nootiiɓe noddaandu Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on tuma nde ɓe noddanoo yahugol ka hare fii laawol diina Alla, ɓe hawroya e sirkooɓe ɓen ka hare "hamraa' al Asad" hikkiinde nden uhud, ɓaawo nde ɓe barmunoo ñalnde uhud ; ɓe saloraaki noddaandu Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on sabu barme maɓɓe ɗen. Hino woodani ɓen moƴƴimɓe e maɓɓe golle, ɓe huli Alla ɓe ɗoftii Yamrooje Makko ɗen ɓe woɗɗitii Haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin ; njoɓdi mawndi immorde ka Alla, ndi woni Aljanna.
